desc: Ode with Anthropic is an AI services company formed in 2026 by Anthropic alongside a consortium of global investors. Ode brings together Anthropic’s frontier AI models and experienced engineering talent to help enterprise customers design, build, and deploy model-native AI solutions.

name: OMNIA Partners
desc: OMNIA Partners is a leading group purchasing organization (GPO) serving state and local governments, K-12 education, and colleges and universities in the public sector as well as private sector businesses.

name: Pace Analytical Services
desc: Pace is a leading domestic provider of testing and analytical lab services to the environmental and life sciences markets. Pace operates the largest U.S. environmental sciences lab network and offers a broad portfolio of integrated life science testing and clinical manufacturing services.

name: Parts Town
desc: Parts Town is a leading, technology-enabled parts distributor and service provider to the foodservice equipment and residential appliance markets, supporting local, national and international customers.

name: Patient Funding Alternatives
desc: Patient Funding Alternatives is a tech-enabled, patient advocacy platform that helps eligible Medicaid individuals receive commercial insurance coverage through available government programs.

name: PDC Brands
desc: PDC Brands is a leading beauty and wellness company focused on the fastest growing segments of the mass market. PDC Brands’ portfolio of category-leading brands includes Cantu, Dr. Teal’s, and Eylure.

name: PlayCore
desc: PlayCore is a leading manufacturer of playground equipment, park site amenities, recreational surfacing products, fitness equipment, and other specialty products for indoor and outdoor spaces.

name: Press Ganey
desc: Press Ganey is the #1 provider of data, analytics and performance improvement services to hospitals and other healthcare provider clients with a mission to reduce suffering and improve the overall safety, quality and experience of care. Press Ganey utilizes patient and employee surveys to collect vast amounts of proprietary data on behalf of clients to power its industry-leading benchmarking and analytics tools and advisory services.

name: ProMach
desc: ProMach is a leading provider of complete packaging machinery solutions, engineering and integration services, and related aftermarket products and services. ProMach serves nearly all of the Fortune 500 Food, Beverage, and Pharmaceutical companies.

name: Prometheus Group
desc: Prometheus provides asset-intensive companies with a full suite of EAM software solutions that seek to optimize plant and heavy fixed asset maintenance and operations throughout the entire asset lifecycle.

name: Propio
desc: Propio serves to improve gaps in health equity and access among limited English proficient patients through its tech-enabled language services platform that provides remote, on-demand over-the-phone interpreting, video remote interpreting, and in-person interpretation and translation services primarily in healthcare settings.

name: Pure Gym
desc: Pure Gym is the largest fitness club operator in the U.K. and one of the largest in continental Europe. Pure Gym offers its members convenience with 24/7/365 access at a significant value compared to traditional operators.

name: Pye-Barker Fire & Safety
desc: Pye-Barker is a provider of route-based fire protection services, including monitoring, inspection, maintenance and repair of fire detection and suppression products.

name: Radon Medical Imaging
desc: Radon is a leading independent service organization (“ISO”) of medical diagnostic and biomedical equipment, providing maintenance, repair, and installation services, while also serving as a distributor and dealer of imaging equipment.

name: RedSail Technologies
desc: RedSail is the leading provider of end-to-end workflow software and transaction solutions to community and institutional pharmacies and one of three operators facilitating the electronic transmission of prescriptions between pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers nationwide. RedSail serves the largest network of pharmacies in the United States with more than 12 thousand pharmacy rooftops providing care to 30 million patients and processing more than 495 million claims annually. RedSail also leverages its network scale and broad data rights to offer financial, clinical and data-based programming to pharmacy market constituents.

name: The Shade Store
desc: The Shade Store is a leading omni-channel provider of custom window treatments in the United States. The Shade Store offers a complete range of design, manufacturing, measuring and installation services for both consumers and design professionals.

name: SRS Distribution
desc: SRS is one of the largest roofing products, landscaping and pool supply distributors in the United States. The Company serves as a critical link between its supplier partners and a highly fragmented base of contractor customers.

name: Stella Environmental Services
desc: Stella Environmental Services is a leading provider of fully outsourced transfer station management services to the municipal solid waste industry.

name: Stepping Stones Group
desc: Stepping Stones is a leading clinical staffing provider of related therapy, autism, and behavioral health services for children. The Company matches children with a network of passionate, experienced therapists who are focused on improving quality of life and providing high quality, cost efficient essential services.

name: Sun Auto Tire & Service
desc: Sun Auto is a leading multi-unit provider of auto aftermarket maintenance, repair, and tire replacement services.

name: Tecta America
desc: Tecta America is the nation’s leading commercial roofing services platform, with locations serving a broad range of customers across the United States. Tecta provides commercial re-roofing, new installation and roof service and maintenance to a wide variety of end markets.

name: TenCate
desc: TenCate is the largest vertically integrated manufacturer, distributor, designer, and installer of artificial turf solutions to the global sports and outdoor living markets.

name: Topgolf
desc: Topgolf is a leading platform of tech-enabled, off-course golf entertainment. Topgolf operates open-air venues with an immersive gameplay experience powered by its proprietary Toptracer ball-tracking technology while providing high quality food & beverage offerings.

name: Troon Golf
desc: Troon is the world’s largest third-party management company focused on golf-related hospitality, providing long-term contracted services to leading clubs and courses globally. The Company is also the #1 provider of tennis and caddie management services.

name: Union Square Hospitality Group (USHG)
desc: Union Square Hospitality Group (“USHG”) is a renowned restaurant management group founded by Danny Meyer. USHG operates fine-dining and casual restaurants, museum cafes, a wine bar, a catering company and coffee shops/bakeries.

name: Velvet Taco
desc: Velvet Taco is a premium fast-casual taco restaurant concept that features a diverse variety of chef-driven, culinary-forward tacos.

name: Veritext
desc: Veritext is the leading pre-trial deposition services provider in the United States, offering end-to-end services for law firms and corporate clients. Veritext connects its clients to its network of independent court contractors, including court reporters, videographers, and interpreters, to help administer more depositions per year than any other provider.

name: Visual Comfort & Co.
desc: Visual Comfort is a leading provider of decorative and functional lighting as well as ceiling fan products primarily serving the residential end-market. The Company offers its products to wholesale, retail and interior design customers through a diversified omni-channel approach, including independent showrooms, electrical distributors, third party e-commerce, interior design firms, private label, and its own Circa Lighting physical showroom footprint.

name: Vital Care
desc: Vital Care Infusion Services is a franchisor of infusion pharmacies, dedicated to serving secondary, tertiary, and underserved communities across the United States. The Vital Care franchise network spans the country, with more than 160 infusion pharmacy locations providing high-quality, safe, convenient, cost-effective infusion therapy services for chronic and acute patients at a local level. Through Vital Care’s streamlined, proprietary process and best-in-class support, network’s locally owned and operated pharmacies provide patients with better access to care, convenience and improved clinical outcomes, while saving costs for the broader U.S. healthcare system.

name: WCG
desc: WCG is a leading provider of clinical trial solutions, focused on providing solutions that are designed to measurably improve the quality and efficiency of clinical research, stimulate growth and foster compliance.

name: WellSky
desc: WellSky is a leading provider of enterprise software and services to healthcare provider companies primarily in the post-acute care market.

name: West Shore Home
desc: West Shore Home is a leading direct-to-consumer residential services platform providing remodeling services for bath/shower, window, and door projects.

name: The Wrench Group
desc: The Wrench Group is a leading provider of home repair, replacement, and maintenance services specializing in heating, ventilation and air conditioning (“HVAC”), plumbing, water, and electrical services.

name: Zaxby’s
desc: Zaxby’s is an authentic, founder-run franchisor and operator of quick service restaurants specializing in chicken.

name: 8am
desc: 8am is a leading cloud-based provider of practice management software, integrated payments and embedded fintech solutions for small and midsize businesses, with a market-leading position in the legal end market. Since 2005, the Company has grown to serve over 90,000+ clients spanning legal, accounting, association, and other professional service verticals in North America.

name: ACA Group
desc: ACA is a leading end-to-end provider of technology-enabled GRC solutions to the financial services industry. ACA’s offerings include regulatory compliance, distribution solutions, performance solutions, RegTech, risk and cybersecurity advisory, and ESG advisory. The company serves over 6,000 clients, including private equity firms, hedge funds, traditional asset managers, wealth managers, and diversified financial institutions.

name: Advarra
desc: Advarra is a leading provider of institutional review board (IRB), institutional biosafety committee (IBC) and research quality and compliance services, which are mandated by regulatory agencies for all trial protocols, patient forms, site initiations and trial modifications. The Company serves leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device and contract research organizations (CROs), as well as academic medical centers, hospital systems, investigative site networks, and therapeutic research consortia, and has relationships with over 3,200 institutional sites.

name: Alera Group
desc: Alera Group (“Alera”) is an employee benefits and insurance brokerage platform originally formed through the merger of 24 entrepreneurial and high performing independent agencies.  Alera is currently one of the largest privately held insurance brokerage firms in the U.S.  It has over 750 employees and serves more than 20,000 clients nationally through a local distribution model.

name: AmeriLife
desc: AmeriLife provides outsourced distribution of insurance and retirement solutions to the U.S. senior market, marketing and distributing a holistic suite of health insurance, life insurance, annuity and retirement planning solutions and services through independent and career agents.

name: Amwins Group
desc: Founded in 1998, Amwins Group, Inc. is one of the largest independent wholesale distributors of specialty insurance products in the world. With over 125 U.S. and 19 international office locations, Amwins maintains relationships with 25,000+ retail agencies and a wide range of carriers. The Company operates through five divisions: Wholesale Brokerage, Access, Specialty Underwriting, Group Benefits, and International.

name: Aperture
desc: Aperture is a national provider of forensic engineering and expert services to law firms, insurance companies, and corporations. The company serves clients in litigation by identifying root causes, establishing severity, and assisting with case building.

name: Apex Group
desc: Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With 60+ offices across 30+ countries worldwide, Apex Group delivers an expansive range of services to asset managers, financial institutions, private clients and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry; including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody, super ManCo services, corporate services including HR and Payroll and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory solution.

name: Arrowhead Engineered Products
desc: Arrowhead Engineered Products is a leading global provider of non-discretionary, proprietary-branded, aftermarket replacement parts. The Company provides mission-critical parts for outdoor power equipment, powersports, agriculture, industrial, golf & marine as well as on-road end markets through a family of well-known brands. Arrowhead delivers a superior value proposition built around product quality, supply chain and customer service. AEP is headquartered in Blaine, MN and has a facility footprint across North America and Europe.

name: Ascensus
desc: Ascensus is a technology‐enabled service provider focused on recordkeeping and administration in the U.S. qualified retirement (e.g. 401(k) plans) and 529 plan markets. The Company offers independent, low cost operating platforms for intermediaries selling 529 and micro to small sized retirement plans. Ascensus is headquartered in Dresher, PA

name: Association Member Benefits Advisors
desc: Association Member Benefits Advisors (“AMBA”) is a national affinity marketing insurance agency focused on distributing supplemental insurance and other voluntary benefits through a proprietary network of retired teacher, educator, and public employee associations across the United States.  The Company partners with established carriers and utilizes a salesforce of captive agents to distribute a portfolio of products, including vision, dental, long-term care, annuities, cancer, emergency medical transportation, Medicare supplement, heart, life, and accident insurance.

name: Brook + Whittle
desc: Brook + Whittle is a leading North American manufacturer of premium prime label solutions with highly differentiated capabilities, entrusted by some of the most well-known brands. The Company provides pressure-sensitive labels, shrink sleeves and flexible packaging, with a focus on sustainable solutions and decorative effects requiring significant technical expertise. With a heritage rooted in product development and comprehensive in-house manufacturing, the Company draws on its wide variety of specialized printing expertise, including flexographic, rotogravure, and digital.

name: Bullhorn
desc: Bullhorn is the market leading software vendor exclusively focused on the staffing and recruitment industry. The company provides mission critical software including CRM, applicant tracking system, vendor management system access, onboarding, and back office automation for over 6,600 customers.

name: Cerity Partners
desc: Cerity Partners is a leading provider of comprehensive financial management services to a diverse spectrum of High Net Worth (“HNW”) individuals and their families, businesses and their executives, and nonprofit organizations. The Company’s holistic approach to wealth management includes investment and non-investment services such as tax, estate, and insurance planning. Additionally, Cerity serves businesses and non-profits through its retirement plan advisory offerings, and its unique executive financial counseling (“EFC”) solution.

name: Cetera Financial Group
desc: Cetera Financial Group is a leading network of independent firms empowering the delivery of professional financial advice to individuals, families and company retirement plans across the country through trusted financial advisors and financial institutions. Key services include award-winning wealth management and advisory platforms, comprehensive broker-dealer and registered investment adviser services, practice management support and innovative technology.

name: Clarience Technologies
desc: Clarience Technologies is a major producer of forward and safety lighting, wiring harnesses, turn signal switches and safety accessories for the medium- and heavy-duty truck, trailer and commercial vehicle industries. The company also designs and manufactures Road Ready® telematics systems for heavy- and light-duty trailers and off-road industrial usage; fuel filtration and water separation systems; and rugged LED lighting for the off-road and marine industries.

name: ConnectiveRx
desc: ConnectiveRx (formerly PSKW-PDR) is a healthcare software and payments company that provides patient and provider support, with access and adherence solutions for specialty and branded medications. The Company’s services include a patient engagement and support platform, patient and provider adherence messaging, and patient affordability programs. ConnectiveRx’s wide array of services and innovative solutions accelerate speed-to-therapy, by increasing access and adherence, resulting in improved outcomes for patients and healthcare overall.

name: Cyncly
desc: Cyncly is a global provider of specialized computer-aided design (CAD), configure, price, quote (CPQ) and enterprise solutions dedicated to interior design, space planning and furniture manufacturing. Cyncly’s mission-critical applications provide end-to-end solutions designed to optimize efficiency and improve productivity for the Company’s vast global network of customers, which includes more than 50,000 independent kitchen and bath dealers as well as many of the world’s largest home improvement retailers and manufacturers.

name: Daxko
desc: Daxko is a provider of member management software and integrated payments solutions to the health and wellness market. Daxko’s customers include enterprise health clubs, boutique fitness studios, affiliate gyms, campus recreation facilities, integrated wellness centers, YMCAs, and JCCs. Since 1998, the company has grown to serve customers spanning 140+ countries, nearly 17,000 facilities, and over 25 million+ members.

name: Docupace
desc: Docupace is a leading provider of software to streamline back-office operations of wealth management enterprises and financial advisors. Financial services firms use the Docupace Platform to reduce back-office expenses, improve efficiency, strengthen recruiting, and enhance the experience of advisors and investors.

name: First Eagle Investments
desc: First Eagle is a global multi-strategy asset manager that seeks to generate attractive absolute returns over the long-term with an emphasis on disciplined, value-oriented, and free cash flow focused investment approaches with AUM across public markets and alternative credit investment vehicles.

name: Flourish
desc: Flourish is a leading clinical trial site management organization (SMO) with expertise across a variety of therapeutic areas, trial phases, and customer types. The Company’s integrated network of sites and principal investigators conduct over 1,000 unique studies spanning all phases of clinical trial research and is supported by centralized leadership, technology platform and recruiting capabilities.

name: Inside Real Estate
desc: Inside Real Estate is a rapidly growing provider of residential real estate software, offering solutions for the front and back offices of brokerages and teams. IRE’s flagship platform (kvCORE) enables agents to build their brands and grow their business through CRM, listing tools, and transaction workflow; it also offers an agent-focused marketplace with proprietary and third-party products used to drive additional exposure of the broker or agent’s existing listings and generate new leads.

name: insightsoftware
desc: insightsoftware helps companies turn their financial and operational data into better business outcomes that drive growth and ROI.  insightsoftware’s reporting and performance management solutions provide users with real-time and drill-down access to insights in an efficient, cost-effective and secure manner.  The Company’s products support over 130 tier 1 and tier 2 ERP systems for more than 25,000 customers.

name: Jet Support Services, Inc.
desc: JSSI is the leading independent provider of maintenance support and financial services to the business aviation industry. The Company supports thousands of business jets and helicopters across the globe through its maintenance programs and software and serves customers through an infrastructure of certified technical advisors. JSSI leverages this technical knowledge, experience, buying power and data to provide support at every stage of the aircraft lifecycle, from aircraft acquisition to aircraft teardown and part out.

name: Lightspeed Systems
desc: Lightspeed Systems (“Lightspeed”), is a trusted partner in learning safety and effectiveness for the K-12 market. The Lightspeed ecosystem of cloud-based solutions provides schools worldwide with web filtering, student safety monitoring, classroom management, device management, and analytics solutions.

name: Likewize
desc: Likewize is a global provider of cell phone and electronic device protection products and services, resolving hundreds of millions of customer issues each year across insurance, warranty, repairs, trade-ins, recycling, and premium tech support. The Company serves a wide array of clients including carriers, financial institutions, retailers, and mobile phone OEMs across the world.

name: MASA Global
desc: MASA Global (“MASA”) offers pre-paid membership programs providing coverage for medical emergency transportation services, including ground ambulance, helicopter, and chartered aircraft between healthcare providers both domestically and internationally. Memberships are currently sold through five well-established sales channels: direct-to-consumer, employers, international, third party brokers, and funeral homes / final expense providers.

name: Mercer Advisors
desc: Mercer Advisors is a leading independent RIA with over 30 years of wealth management experience. The company primarily services the mass-affluent and high-net-worth clients. Mercer attracts and retains clients by offering comprehensive wealth management solutions, including: financial planning, investment management, tax management, retirement income and benefits planning, and estate planning.

name: mSupply
desc: mSupply is the leading distributor of OEM branded residential appliance repair parts. mSupply has distribution agreements with all the leading OEMs and a multi-channel sales strategy across service providers, extended warranty providers, internet/DIY users and property managers. mSupply’s availability model includes a long tail of 75,000+ SKUs used by 20,000+ service providers who service ~15 million homes annually.

name: Numerix
desc: Numerix is a leading provider of innovative capital markets technology solutions and real-time intelligence applications for trading and risk management. Its mission critical technology supports decision making from pre-trade price discovery through XVA trading, market and counterparty credit risk management across all asset classes.

name: OEConnection
desc: OEConnection (“OEC”) is the leading global automotive technology provider for OEM distribution networks. Its suite of SaaS ecommerce, pricing, supply chain, business intelligence, parts cataloging and data products help automakers and their dealer networks sell more OE parts in the collision, fleet, mechanical and retail segments, as well as dealers’ own service lanes. OEC serves more than 30,000 auto dealers globally, 36 global OEM brands and more than 135,000 global auto repairers. The Company is headquartered in the greater Cleveland area in Richfield, Ohio.

name: Oncourse Home Solutions
desc: Oncourse Home Solutions is a leading home protection provider focused on protecting more than 2 million customers from unexpected costs by providing flexible services for home repairs and maintenance across the country. With more than three decades of experience, Oncourse Home Solutions has stayed committed to simplifying the hassles of home care and providing coverage that simply works, giving homeowners peace of mind.

name: Orion Advisor Solutions
desc: Orion Advisor Solutions is a leading provider of integrated wealth management software and turnkey asset management solutions, serving independent fiduciary advisors across the United States. The Orion Advisor Solutions brand entities create a complete yet modular offering that empowers firms to seamlessly attract new clients; connect goals more meaningfully to investment strategies and outcomes; and ultimately track progress towards each investor’s unique definition of financial success.

name: OTC Industrial Technologies
desc: .  Founded in 1963 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, OTC’s geographic footprint includes over 60 locations, along with nearly 40 service shops. OTC employs over 1600 employees across the United States.

name: PDI
desc: PDI provides enterprise software and solutions to the leading convenience retailers, wholesale petroleum marketers and logistics carriers. Over 1,200 customers in more than 50 countries rely on PDI’s software for retail, wholesale and logistics automation, financial reporting, business insights, workforce management and end-to-end fuel supply chain.

name: PlayMetrics
desc: PlayMetrics is a leading provider of operations management software for youth sports organizations. PlayMetrics is purpose-built to simplify the unique complexities of running a club, league, tournament, or governing body, empowering directors, coaches, administrators, and player families to modernize their daily operations with unified financial, operational, coaching, and communication tools.

name: Procure Analytics
desc: Procure Analytics is the leading software-centric, data-forward group purchasing organization for MRO and Packaging, leveraging $1B+ in buying power to achieve savings for member companies. PA’s team leads change management, drives adoption, and increases compliance at member locations, while providing analytical tools, savings reporting, and buyer training to drive continuous value growth for SMEs to Fortune 100 companies.

name: Prometheus Group
desc: Prometheus is an industry leading provider of comprehensive and intuitive plant maintenance operations and optimization software.  Its solutions utilize data analytics to deliver a uniform experience across the platform and are trusted by the largest asset-intensive companies in the world operating in the oil & gas, chemical, pulp & paper, mining & metals, and utilities industries.  Founded in 1998 and based in Raleigh, NC, the company has a global operating footprint and customer base and has over 300 employees.

name: Richey May
desc: Richey May is a full-service firm providing accounting, tax, and advisory services to clients across diverse industries and geographic markets. Richey May will operate under an alternative practice structure pursuant to which Genstar will not have an equity interest in the attest services business of Richey May.

name: SEER
desc: The SEER Group (“SEER”) is a leading provider of home services, including heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (“HVAC”), along with electrical and plumbing. SEER is headquartered in Seattle, WA and operates through 700+ trained technicians across the Pacific Northwest and Western U.S markets.

name: Signant Health
desc: Signant Health was formed in 2018 by the merger of CRF Health and Bracket to provide life science companies with patient-centric technology solutions that advance clinical research and transform the patient experience. The company’s integrated suite of applications combine advanced analytics and therapeutic area-specific scientific consulting, and are trusted by pharmaceutical companies of all sizes, including all of the top 20 pharmas, as well as CROs, biotechs, and academic institutions on over 4,000 global clinical trials.

name: Sonny’s Enterprises
desc: Sonny’s is the leading manufacturer of conveyorized car wash systems with a complete, integrated suite of equipment, controls, aftermarket parts and chemicals. The Company serves both small independents and large national car wash chains throughout the United States as the only one-stop provider of end-to-end car wash solutions for new investors and existing operators, including education, proformas and consulting, and local services and support.  Headquartered in Tamarac, FL, Sonny’s draws on 40+ years of industry leadership to drive deep relationships with its over 6,000 active customers nationwide.

name: Tekni-Plex
desc: Tekni-Plex is a leading global manufacturer of highly engineered products, components and materials for niche healthcare, specialty packaging, and food packaging applications. The Company’s products include medical tubing and compounds, pharma barrier films, dispensing components, closure liners and protective packaging, and primarily serve the medical & pharmaceutical, food & beverage, household & industrial, and personal care end markets.

name: TERREPOWER
desc: TERREPOWER supplies non-discretionary replacement parts in the North American automotive aftermarket, primarily focused on the do-it-for-me (“DIFM”) light vehicle aftermarket and serves vehicle owners, professional technicians and franchised dealers.  TERREPOWER has a broad product offering, including starters, alternators, hydraulic steering, brake calipers, electric power assisted steering (“EPAS”) and turbochargers.

name: Vector Solutions
desc: Vector Solutions is the leading provider of award-winning, intelligent SaaS solutions that help organizations and individuals operate at the highest level and prepare for more challenging workplaces and environments. Providing industry-focused solutions that connect information and technology, its unique product set includes training management, continuing education (CE), compliance training, workforce scheduling, safety management, and more.
